title: Finite evaluation and concentration of composite tower orientation arrows
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be smooth separated morphisms of pure relative dimensions $d,e\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and put $h=gf$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the strict varying-coefficient tower categories [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], their ordinary derived categories and exact evaluations $\mathrm{ev}_n$ [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and their full subcategories with uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor levels [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. No normalization of inputs is assumed. All tensor products are ordinary derived tensors over $A_\bullet$, with the levelwise derived pullback and Tate twists [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor, def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

For $u=f,g,h$ write $G_{u,\bullet}=u^!_\bullet$, $\omega_{u,\bullet}=G_{u,\bullet}A_{\bullet,\mathrm{target}(u)}$, $L_{u,\bullet}=A_{\bullet,\mathrm{source}(u)}(d_u)[2d_u]$, where $d_f=d,d_g=e,d_h=d+e$. Let $a_{u,\bullet}:L_{u,\bullet}\simeq\omega_{u,\bullet}$ and $t_{u,\bullet,K}$ be the specified diagonal orientation and counit-defined tensor maps [det-sp-tower-gamma, det-sp-tower-gluing]. Use the counit-normalized exceptional compositor $c_\bullet:G_{h,\bullet}\simeq G_{f,\bullet}G_{g,\bullet}$ [det-sp-composition-comparisons]. Put
$$W_\bullet=f^*\omega_{g,\bullet}\otimes^L\omega_{f,\bullet},\quad \rho_\bullet=t_{f,\bullet,\omega_{g,\bullet}},\quad \mu_\bullet=\rho_\bullet^{-1}c_{\bullet,1}.$$
The map $\rho_\bullet$ is invertible, and the two arrows
$$\Phi_\bullet=\mu_\bullet a_{h,\bullet},\qquad \Psi_\bullet=f^*a_{g,\bullet}\otimes a_{f,\bullet}$$
are actual derived tower maps from $L_{h,\bullet}$ to $W_\bullet$ under shifted-Tate tensor splitting. Their exact evaluations are respectively
$$\mathrm{ev}_n(\Phi_\bullet)=\mu_n a_{h,A_n},\qquad \mathrm{ev}_n(\Psi_\bullet)=f^*a_{g,A_n}\otimes a_{f,A_n},$$
where $\mu_n=t_{f,A_n,\omega_{g,A_n}}^{-1}c_{A_n,1}$ and all finite arrows are those of [det-sp-finite-general-ring, det-sp-composition-comparisons]. Both $L_{h,\bullet}$ and $W_\bullet$ have cohomology only in degree $-2(d+e)$, and their cohomology sheaves have locally free rank-one finite evaluations. These assertions include quotient transitions and the actual adjunction units and counits; they make no assertion of faithfulness of evaluation on arbitrary derived Hom groups.

proof.text: Use the finite_levels fields of the three GIVEN purity records [def-sp-tower-gamma-data] for the finite orientations, geometries and normalized unit identifications. The proved unit-normalization lemma [lem-sp-tower-orientation-word-normalization] converts their targetWord square into the dualizingWord square. At K=omega_g, the given af.purity_iso makes gamma invertible. The first gamma factor is tensor of identity with the isomorphism af.orientation. Mathlib IsIso.of_isIso_fac_left therefore proves invertibility of the actual towerRho. No new purity record is selected.

Apply [lem-sp-tower-tate-split-normalized] to obtain the actual shifted Tate splitting s with exactly TowerSplitNormalized. This supplies the finite formula for s before either orientation is composed into it.

Apply [lem-sp-ordered-tate-tower-cohomology] to X, wh and r=d+e. It gives concentration and locally free rank-one finite evaluations for the source orderedLine, including the coefficient unit and the empty scheme.

Form the actual isomorphism PsiIso by composing s with tensor of pullback of ag.orientation and af.orientation. Homology and exact evaluation preserve isomorphisms. Transport off-degree IsZero and surviving IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank along these isomorphisms to obtain concentration of W.

For each of the two constructed tower arrows, apply cal.reduction.reduction_naturality to its image under inverse realization. These are exactly TowerOrientationReduction, for every m<=n, including equality. No finite-evaluation faithfulness statement is needed.

For each level choose F,G,H from step 1. Apply [lem-sp-tower-mu-evaluation] with their normalized unit comparisons. Paste H.evaluated with the resulting mu square to obtain the finite Phi square. For Psi, naturality of exactSitePull, the geometric pull comparison and pullEvaluation transports G.evaluated through pullWord. Apply [lem-sp-tensor-word-comparison]: naturality of the site tensor comparison in both variables, tc.derived and tensorEvaluation transports this square and F.evaluated through tensorWord. Paste that square with TowerSplitNormalized at n. Functor.map_comp gives the two displayed composite finite arrows.
